objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.witness: In (5) the highlighted linear term 4c(c-e)n is not the actual coefficient of n in the expanded expression (that is 2c^2-4ce+2c(x_0-y_0)); the value 4c(c-e) only emerges after using the near-diagonal relation em ≈ cn. Moreover the stated O(n+m) remainder subsumes all linear terms, making (5) vacuous as written. The correct per-case coefficients (4cq(c-e)k, 4c(c-e)n_k+O(1)) are asserted without derivation, though both are in fact correct.
